The formal public notice dated 14 June 2025 states that GA Digital does not charge a fee for job placement and is not associated with outside brokers acting independently.

The original homepage also displays a notice about a refundable ₹10,000 security deposit at joining, payable in the company’s favor by demand draft, with no cash accepted. This is distinct from a job-placement fee. Verify current applicability directly with the company.
